**Rabbits** are creatures that appear in *Fallout 76*.

Rabbits will not attack the player character, instead running away from any kind of combat. Unmutated Caged Rabbits are also found in Appalachia.

| Name (Form ID) | Abilities | Items | 
| **Rabbit**001111B7 EncCritterRabbit01Template | | | 

| Melee (0 ) | 

- On the hill behind The Whitespring Service Entrance.
- Between Central Mountain lookout and Wendigo Cave.
- Three dead rabbits can be found in the outdoor kitchen of Rollins Labor Camp.
- Three can potentially spawn at the Cultist Totem.
- Grahm's Meat Cook, Event: Fasnacht Day

- Delbert Winters mentions that rabbits can be used to make soup. [1] 

Rabbits appear in *Fallout 76*.
